subject: Qualification MAP + SOC 2 Type II report access request — QuantumWell Health
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@quantumwell.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Stone <emily.stone@quantumwell.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up from demo — SOC 2 Type II and next steps

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo earlier — Jordan's walkthrough was helpful. We have two items on our side before we move the pilot forward: a copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report (or summary) and a bridge letter if the full report can't be shared. Our security team also wants access to whatever secure evidence portal you use so they can spot-check controls.

Specifically:
- Can you provide the Type II report or a redacted summary?
- If the report is restricted, can you provide a bridge/interim attestation?
- What's the process and timeline to get portal credentials or a secure link (S3/SFTP/TrustPortal)?

Emily (cc) is our security lead — she may have a short vendor questionnaire after she reviews the materials. Also looping in procurement (procurement@quantumwell.com) — they will need any procurement paperwork if we move to contract.

Appreciate a quick note on timing. We are trying to complete security clearance this month to hit a September pilot start.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Senior Product Manager
QuantumWell Health

Date: 2026-08-16T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from demo — SOC 2 Type II and next steps

Alex — thanks for the note and for the time today. Recap + proposed MAP below so we align on next steps.

Recap of asks:
- SOC 2 Type II report (or redacted summary)
- Bridge/interim attestation if full report cannot be shared
- Secure evidence portal access (TrustPortal preferred; SFTP fallback)

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Today (EOD): I will request portal access + package a redacted summary and our standard bridge letter.
2) 48 hours: Security receives access + high-level summary PDF (redacted) for initial review.
3) 3–5 business days: If needed, we coordinate a short evidence walk-through with Ben.
4) Procurement: I’ll share a standard GTC + procurement contact for quick review.

Portal options: TrustPortal invite (preferred) — I can provision read-only access scoped to SOC 2 artifacts. SFTP (hosted, ephemeral creds) is available if your security team prefers it.

Attachments I will include in the next email: redwood_bridge_letter.pdf (interim attestation) and soc2-typeii-summary-2025.pdf (redacted summary). Ben, can you confirm if we should include any system diagrams or data-flow docs in the initial package?

If that MAP looks good, I’ll proceed now and loop you back with invites and attachments.

Thanks — talk soon,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: none (will follow)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@quantumwell.com>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@quantumwell.com>, procurement@quantumwell.com
Date: 2026-08-17T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from demo — SOC 2 Type II and next steps

+1 on the MAP. For the initial triage the redacted summary + bridge letter is sufficient. A couple notes for the evidence handoff: 

- Include a short architecture diagram (1 page) showing where data is encrypted at rest/in transit and which components are customer-facing vs private.
- We should also provide the control-owner list (names/titles) for the policies referenced in the report — that speeds up spot checks.
- If they ask for longer retention logs or raw artifacts, we can offer a 1:1 review session; otherwise read-only access to TrustPortal should cover it.

Tessa, happy to join the walk-through if Emily requests it. If TrustPortal access is blocked we can provision a time-limited SFTP drop and share a secure link.

Ben Carter
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference

Summary of deliverables included:
- redwood_bridge_letter.pdf (interim attestation / bridge letter) — explains scope and limitations for a redacted share.
- soc2-typeii-summary-2025.pdf (redacted summary) — high-level scope, auditor opinion, and control families.

TrustPortal invite: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/invite/quantumwell (read-only, scoped to SOC 2 artifacts). If anyone on your team has issues with that sign-in flow, reply-all and we’ll provision an SFTP drop instead (one-time credentials).

Procurement: for contracting speed, our standard order guide (term sheet + GTC) is linked in HubSpot — I copied procurement on this thread. If procurement prefers, I can also provide a DocuSign draft to expedite signatures.

Next suggested steps:
- Emily: review redacted summary this week and let us know if you need a short evidence walk-through.
- Procurement: confirm whether DocuSign or PO flow is preferred.
- Ben/Jordan: stand by for any follow-up evidence requests.

Thanks and speak soon,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0163
